approved: Madhav, 3 Nov 2026 (chat: 'yes to all your recommendations and next steps'; the data audit named V02 and HFN1 as readers of the thin PR files)
title: HFN1 on the timestamped announcements: does FinBERT's reading tell where the stock goes next?

model.source: Hugging Face, downloaded 25 Oct 2026, run locally on the Mac (no fitting, no fine-tuning: zero-shot)
model.input: the announcement's text field (silver/pr/announcements.parquet column text: subject plus body as the PR zip gives it), first 128 tokens
model.output: p_positive, p_negative, p_neutral; label = the largest; tone = p_positive - p_negative
model.second_model: none (yiyanghkust/finbert-tone was considered and NOT registered, so it is not run)

pos|drift5.what: mean drift5 of positive stock-days (quarter means, t over quarters)

spread|drift5.what: per quarter: mean drift5 of positive minus negative stock-days

spread|drift20.what: per quarter: mean drift20 of positive minus negative stock-days

within_cat|drift20.what: per quarter: inside each category, mean drift20 of positive minus negative stock-days, averaged over the categories that have both (beyond the category)

rank|drift20.what: per quarter: Spearman rank correlation between stock-day tone and drift20 across that quarter's stock-days

statistics: quarter blocks (calendar quarter of day d), t over quarter means; dev 2010-2017, validation 2018-2023; at least 16 quarters per period (registry MIN_DATES)

aggregation.stock_day_tone: the mean tone of that stock's announcements that day
aggregation.stock_day_label: positive = at least one positive and no negative announcement; negative = at least one negative and no positive; mixed = both; neutral = all neutral

timing:
(the one rule that differs, because the source has a time of day): an announcement disseminated on a trading day at or before 15:30 IST
is known before that session's close, so its outcome runs from that close (as the PR file of day d after the close of d); after 15:30, or on a
non-trading day, from the close of the next session.
categories: as V02T; nav and share_cert left out (as HFN1)
